side_derivation.conclusion: The field carries no dir of its own, so it inherits rtl from <html dir="rtl">, and the shared .input class adds text-right. Characters are flush against the RIGHT edge and grow leftward, leaving the LEFT side free — so the eye takes left-2 and pl-10 keeps that space reserved when the password is long. Same side as tamlul (02) but reached from the opposite starting point: 02's field carries an explicit dir="ltr".

no_submission_side_effect.method: window.fetch wrapped before the first toggle; counted across both toggles
no_submission_side_effect.note: This page's password field is NOT inside a <form> (measured inForm=false) and the login button is an onClick handler, so there was no implicit-submit risk to begin with. type="button" is set anyway, and the zero-fetch count confirms no signInWithPassword attempt fired on toggle.
